text:
miro: quick thread — proposing a compact ledger + manifest for Redwood Optimize quant profiles. want to capture both bakeoff results and deployment hints so ops + runtime can make deterministic routing.

anya: +1. can you sketch required fields? we've had confusion about which profiles are safe to route to Dedicated vs Hosted.

miro: sure. minimal idea: name, semver, model_ref, quant_backend, bits, calibration_seed, eval_cohort_id, delta_vs_fp16 (pct), perf_summary (p50/p95 tokens/ms), target_latency_ms, memory_est_mb, runtime_tags, compatible_kernels, rollout_recommendation (canary/global), cache_policy, provenance_url.

sam: echo — add 'safety_notes' and 'eval_prompts_snapshot' pointer. also include 'quantized_ops' list so runtime can pick kernel variants.

nora: we should standardize the naming pattern too. proposal: <model>-v<model_semver>__<quant>-<bits>__opt<v>.examples: gpt-neox-v1.2__awq-8__opt1  or falcon-40b-v2__gptq-4__opt2. underscores as separators to avoid weird URL encoding.

anya: agree on separators. what about versioning semantics for "opt"? is that packaging format or tuning iteration?

miro: 'opt' = packaging/optimize profile revision. model_semver stays tied to model weights. quant part denotes algorithm + bitwidth. optN increments when we change eval cohort or rollout hints.

ci-bot: lint check: manifest must be <= 16KB, keys sorted, and have a stable checksum in header. failing manifests will be rejected by profile-registry.

sam: include an example manifest snippet for engineers who will generate these during bakeoffs:
```json
{
  "name": "gpt-neox-v1.2__awq-8__opt1",
  "semver": "1.2.0",
  "model_ref": "models/gpt-neox/1.2.0",
  "quant_backend": "awq",
  "bits": "8",
  "calibration_seed": "2026-11-02T15:00:00Z",
  "eval_cohort_id": "optimize-bakeoff-2026-11",
  "delta_vs_fp16_pct": "-0.6",
  "perf_p50_tokens_ms": "0.85",
  "perf_p95_tokens_ms": "1.4",
  "target_latency_ms": "75",
  "memory_est_mb": "76000",
  "runtime_tags": ["cuda-12","tensorcore-rt"],
  "compatible_kernels": ["fmha_v2","kvcache-streaming"],
  "rollout_recommendation": "canary:5%->30% if delta_vs_fp16_pct < -1.0 and perf_p95 < 1.8",
  "cache_policy": "prefix-kv:enabled",
  "provenance_url": "https://stash/internal/quant-bakeoffs/2026-11/gpt-neox-awq-8",
  "safety_notes": "no harmful regressions detected on safety-cohort-3",
  "eval_prompts_snapshot": "s3://optimize/evals/2026-11/cohort3.jsonl",
  "quantized_ops": ["linear","layernorm"],
  "packaging_checksum": "sha256:abcd...",
  "manifest_schema": "optimize/manifest-v1"
}
```

nora: this looks good. two operational asks: 1) add a 'fallback_variant' field (eg: fp16 or lower-bits) for automatic polyfill when model not available; 2) add a 'max_batch_size' estimate for router batching.

miro: added those to the checklist. also thinking about a short human-readable label field for Console UI, e.g., "AWQ-8 opt1 — gpt-neox v1.2 (canary)".

anya: question — how do we encode accuracy deltas from different eval tasks? single aggregate delta isn't enough sometimes. propose 'delta_breakdown' mapping task->pct, and 'primary_metric' tag.

sam: +1. keep primary_metric one of [perplexity, rouge, exact_match, accuracy] and delta_breakdown keys must match eval suite names.

ci-bot: registry rule: any manifest with delta_breakdown where any task delta > 3.0% must include manual sign-off tag and link to regression-job.automations.

deploy-bot: runtime note: routers will prefer profiles with 'target_latency_ms' <= configured SLO and pick fallback_variant when mem_est > host capacity. please include 'preferred_deploy_modes': ["hosted","dedicated"] so the routing layer can filter.

miro: final ask to team owning bakeoffs: start emitting manifests with these fields in the next bakeoff run. i'll put the checklist in the Optimize repo and add a generator script. @anya can you own the manifest schema PR?

anya: happy to. will draft schema and CI validators by EOD Friday.

sam: i'll update the bakeoff harness to upload manifests and sha256 to registry.

nora: i'll add Console render hooks for the human label and rollout_recommendation parsing.

miro: awesome — thanks. filing follow-ups: #1 schema PR (anya), #2 bakeoff uploader (sam), #3 console hooks (nora).

ci-bot: thread closed: manifest-guidelines-accepted:2087654321
